name: Mr. Taz
description: A mysterious patron in an ill-fitting skin-suit who hires Krenko for heists and pays him with a key to an Orzhov safebox.

timeline.summary: Mr. Taz meets Krenko in a smoky pub and hires him for a Boros heist, giving him a glowing shiv.
timeline.quote: Here is a special tool to help you in your endeavor."

timeline.summary: Krenko delivers the angel's feather to Taz on the Millennial and receives an Orzhov safebox key holding Feather's money.
timeline.quote: Taz handed him a silver key with the Orzhov symbol carved into the shaft.

timeline.summary: Taz hints at a further job in the Orzhova after calling Krenko the boss of something grand.
timeline.quote: I can see you as the boss of something grand.

relations.note: He takes paying jobs from Taz as his patron.
relations.quote: Yes, Krenko liked this slippery-face man who kept offering him delicious jobs.

pages_say.description: A mysterious patron in an ill-fitting skin-suit who hires Krenko for heists and pays him with a key to an Orzhov safebox.
